layers.name: ArchitectureActivationBundle
layers.role: Stage-36-Rehearsal-Moves als Aktivierungsfenster, Commit-Gates, Rollback-Sektionen und Transaktionen prüfen.

layers.name: ArchitectureContractsBundle
layers.role: Kommutierende Diagramme und Kapselverträge gegen Kategorie und Karte validieren.

layers.name: ArchitectureImpactBundle
layers.role: Stage-32-Traces und Boundaries als Impact- und Migration-Gate-Routen prüfen.

layers.name: ArchitectureMapBundle
layers.role: Kapseln, Containment und Datenflüsse stufenweise stabil halten.

layers.name: ArchitectureMigrationBundle
layers.role: Stage-33-Impact-Kandidaten als Wellen, Schritte und Gate-Binding prüfen.

layers.name: ArchitectureRehearsalBundle
layers.role: Stage-34-Migrationsschritte als Trockenlauf-Moves, Gate-Suites und Readiness-Covers prüfen.

layers.name: ArchitectureWitnessBundle
layers.role: Repository-Anker, Witnesses und Obligations vollständig halten.

layers.name: ArithmeticMorphismBundle
layers.role: Stage-38 aktivierte Arithmetik-Morphismen und center.py-Delegation prüfen.

layers.name: CategoryTheoryBundle
layers.role: Kategorien, Funktoren und natürliche Transformationen referenziell geschlossen halten.

layers.name: ConsoleIOMorphismBundle
layers.role: Stage-39 aktivierte Console-/Help-/Utility-Morphismen und center.py-Delegation prüfen.

layers.name: NestedCompletionMorphismBundle
layers.role: Stage-41 aktivierte nestedAlx-Hierarchiecompletion und Legacy-Fassade prüfen.

layers.name: RowRangeMorphismBundle
layers.role: Stage-37 aktivierte Zeilenbereichs-Morphismen und center.py-Delegation prüfen.

layers.name: WordCompletionMorphismBundle

checks.name: CategoryFunctorReferenceCheck
checks.obligation: Every functor must reference known source and target categories.
checks.description: Validiert die Kategorie-Endpunkte aller Funktoren.

checks.name: NaturalTransformationReferenceCheck
checks.obligation: Every natural transformation must reference known source and target functors.
checks.description: Validiert, dass natürliche Transformationen wirklich zwischen registrierten Funktoren liegen.

checks.name: ParadigmTermCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: The architecture snapshot must keep the agreed mathematical paradigm terms visible.
checks.description: Schützt die vereinbarten Begriffe: Topologie, Morphismus, universelle Eigenschaft, Prägarbe, Garbe, Kategorie, Funktor, natürliche Transformation.

checks.name: ArchitectureMapStageCheck
checks.obligation: The capsule map must advertise the current staged architecture level.
checks.description: Prüft, dass Stage 42 in der Architekturkarte sichtbar ist.

checks.name: ArchitectureFlowCapsuleReferenceCheck
checks.obligation: Every architecture flow must connect known capsules.
checks.description: Prüft die Datenflusskanten der Kapselkarte.

checks.name: CapsuleContainmentReferenceCheck
checks.obligation: Containment edges must point to known capsules or registered meta bundles.
checks.description: Prüft die stufenweise Kapsel-In-Kapsel-Struktur.

checks.name: CapsuleContractCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every capsule in the map must have exactly one contract and every contract must belong to a capsule.
checks.description: Prüft die Kapselgrenzen gegen die Stage-29/31-Verträge.

checks.name: ContractReferenceValidationCheck
checks.obligation: The built-in contract reference validation must pass.
checks.description: Übernimmt und bündelt die Referenzprüfung aus ArchitectureContractsBundle.

checks.name: DiagramCategoryFunctorTransformationCheck
checks.obligation: Every commutative diagram must reference known categories, functors and natural transformations.
checks.description: Prüft die natürliche-Transformationen-Verträge gegen die Kategorie-Theorie-Schicht.

checks.name: WitnessValidationCheck
checks.obligation: The Stage-30 witness validation must pass under the Stage-31 category/contract graph.
checks.description: Bündelt die Anker-, Diagramm-, Gesetz- und Natürlichkeits-Witness-Prüfung.

checks.name: CapsuleSliceCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every map capsule must have a concrete capsule slice witness.
checks.description: Prüft, dass jede Kapsel stufenweise und kapselweise auf konkrete reta-Teile rückgebunden ist.

checks.name: DiagramWitnessCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every commutative diagram must have a concrete diagram witness.
checks.description: Prüft, dass kein kommutierendes Diagramm nur symbolisch bleibt.

checks.name: RefactorLawObligationCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every refactor law must be represented as a future-stage obligation.
checks.description: Prüft, dass alle Refactor-Gesetze als Obligations für spätere Stages sichtbar sind.

checks.name: NaturalTransformationWitnessCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every natural transformation must be witnessed by at least one contract diagram.
checks.description: Prüft die Natürlichkeitsabdeckung von Raw→Canonical bis Stage-31-Validierung.

checks.name: ArchitectureTraceValidationCheck
checks.obligation: The Stage-32 trace graph must validate owner, capsule, stage and route coverage.
checks.description: Bündelt die interne Stage-32-Trace-Validierung.

checks.name: ComponentTraceCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every legacy mapping must have a navigable component trace.
checks.description: Prüft alte-reta-Komponente → Kapsel → Kategorie/Witness-Spur.

checks.name: CapsuleTraceCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every architecture capsule must have a capsule trace.
checks.description: Prüft Kapsel-Traces.

checks.name: StageTraceCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every staged refactor step must have a trace row.
checks.description: Prüft Stage-Historie-Traces.

checks.name: BoundaryValidationStatusCheck
checks.obligation: The Stage-32 import-boundary validation must pass.
checks.description: Bündelt Kapselgrenzen, Modulbesitz und Importgraph in die Gesamtvalidierung.

checks.name: ImpactValidationStatusCheck
checks.obligation: The Stage-33 impact validation must pass.
checks.description: Bündelt Impact-Quellen, betroffene Verträge, natürliche Transformationen und Regression-Gates in die Gesamtvalidierung.

checks.name: MigrationGateCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every guarded migration candidate must be protected by concrete regression gates.
checks.description: Prüft, dass spätere Extraktionen aus Legacy-Flächen nur über benannte Gates laufen.

checks.name: MigrationValidationStatusCheck
checks.obligation: The Stage-34 migration-plan validation must pass.
checks.description: Bündelt Migration-Wellen, Schritte, Gate-Bindings, Diagramme und natürliche Transformationen in die Gesamtvalidierung.

checks.name: MigrationGateBindingCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every migration step must have a bound gate command set.
checks.description: Prüft, dass Stage-34-Migrationsschritte nicht ohne Gate-Bindings geplant werden.

checks.name: RehearsalValidationStatusCheck
checks.obligation: The Stage-35 rehearsal bundle must validate its dry-run moves, covers and gate suites.
checks.description: Prüft den Status der Stage-35-Rehearsal-Schicht.

checks.name: RehearsalGateCommandCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every gate rehearsal must expose executable preflight and postflight commands.
checks.description: Prüft die Gate-Kommandos der Stage-35-Trockenlauf-Suiten.

checks.name: ActivationValidationStatusCheck
checks.obligation: The Stage-36 activation bundle must validate activation units, gates, rollbacks and transactions.
checks.description: Prüft den Status der Stage-36-Aktivierungs-/Commit-Schicht.

checks.name: ActivationGateCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every activation unit must have a commit gate suite.
checks.description: Prüft, dass Stage-36-Aktivierungen nicht ohne Commit-Gates stehen.

checks.name: ActivationRollbackCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every activation unit must have a rollback section.
checks.description: Prüft die Rollback-Sektionen der Stage-36-Aktivierungseinheiten.

checks.name: ActivationTransactionCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: Every activation window must glue to a ready transaction.
checks.description: Prüft das universelle Gluing lokaler Aktivierungen in Transaktionsfenster.

checks.name: RowRangeActivationStageCheck
checks.obligation: The row-range morphism bundle must advertise Stage 37 and exist as a source file.
checks.description: Prüft, dass der aktivierte Parser als Stage-37-Schicht sichtbar ist.

checks.name: RowRangeCenterDelegationCheck
checks.obligation: Legacy center row-range functions must delegate to RowRangeMorphismBundle.
checks.description: Schützt center.py als dünne Kompatibilitätsfassade für Zeilenbereichslogik.

checks.name: RowRangeMorphismCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: The activated bundle must expose the essential row-range morphisms.
checks.description: Prüft Morphismen für Validierung, Generator-Literal und Zeilenmengen-Expansion.

checks.name: RowRangeSampleExpansionCheck
checks.obligation: Representative row-range expressions must still expand to the expected row sets.
checks.description: Schützt die beobachtbare Semantik kleiner Zeilenbereichsbeispiele.

checks.name: ArithmeticActivationStageCheck
checks.obligation: The arithmetic morphism bundle must advertise Stage 38 and exist as a source file.
checks.description: Prüft, dass die aktivierte Arithmetik als Stage-38-Schicht sichtbar ist.

checks.name: ArithmeticCenterDelegationCheck
checks.obligation: Legacy center arithmetic functions must delegate to ArithmeticMorphismBundle.
checks.description: Schützt center.py als dünne Kompatibilitätsfassade für Faktor-/Teiler-/Primfaktorlogik.

checks.name: ArithmeticMorphismCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: The activated bundle must expose the essential arithmetic morphisms.
checks.description: Prüft Morphismen für Faktorpaare, Teiler-Gluing, Primfaktoren und Digit-Erkennung.

checks.name: ArithmeticSampleExpansionCheck
checks.obligation: Representative arithmetic helpers must still return the expected legacy results.
checks.description: Schützt die beobachtbare Semantik kleiner Arithmetikbeispiele.

checks.name: ConsoleIOActivationStageCheck
checks.obligation: The console/io morphism bundle must advertise Stage 39 and exist as a source file.
checks.description: Prüft, dass die aktivierte Console-/Help-/Utility-Schicht als Stage-39-Schicht sichtbar ist.

checks.name: ConsoleIOCenterDelegationCheck
checks.obligation: Legacy center console/help/utility functions must delegate to ConsoleIOMorphismBundle.
checks.description: Schützt center.py als dünne Kompatibilitätsfassade für Hilfe-/Output-/Utilitylogik.

checks.name: ConsoleIOMorphismCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: The activated bundle must expose the essential console/help/utility morphisms.
checks.description: Prüft Morphismen für Hilfe, Wrapping, CLI-Ausgabe, Debug-Ausgabe und endliche Hilfssektionen.

checks.name: ConsoleIOSampleExpansionCheck
checks.obligation: Representative console/io helpers must still return the expected legacy helper results.
checks.description: Schützt die beobachtbare Semantik kleiner Utility-Beispiele.

checks.name: WordCompletionActivationStageCheck
checks.obligation: The word-completion morphism bundle must advertise Stage 40 and exist as a source file.
checks.description: Prüft, dass die aktivierte Word-Completion-Schicht als Stage-40-Schicht sichtbar ist.

checks.name: WordCompleterFacadeDelegationCheck
checks.obligation: Legacy word_completerAlx.WordCompleter must be a facade for ArchitectureWordCompleter.
checks.description: Schützt word_completerAlx.py als dünne Kompatibilitätsfassade für Completion-Matching.

checks.name: WordCompletionMorphismCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: The activated bundle must expose the essential word-completion morphisms.
checks.description: Prüft Morphismen für Wortquellen, Cursor-Präfixe, Matching und Completion-Kandidaten.

checks.name: WordCompletionSampleExpansionCheck
checks.obligation: Representative word-completion helpers must still return the expected legacy candidates.
checks.description: Schützt die beobachtbare Semantik kleiner Completion-Beispiele.

checks.name: NestedCompletionActivationStageCheck
checks.obligation: The nested-completion morphism bundle must advertise Stage 41 and exist as a source file.
checks.description: Prüft, dass die aktivierte Nested-Completion-Schicht als Stage-41-Schicht sichtbar ist.

checks.name: NestedCompleterFacadeDelegationCheck
checks.obligation: Legacy nestedAlx.NestedCompleter must be a facade for ArchitectureNestedCompleter.
checks.description: Schützt nestedAlx.py als dünne Kompatibilitätsfassade für hierarchische Prompt-Completion.

checks.name: NestedCompletionMorphismCoverageCheck
checks.obligation: The activated bundle must expose the essential nested-completion morphisms.
checks.description: Prüft Morphismen für Sub-Completer-Auswahl, Gleich-/Kommawerte und Completion-Erzeugung.

checks.name: NestedCompletionSampleExpansionCheck
checks.obligation: Representative nested-completion helpers must still expose the expected legacy class and situations.
checks.description: Schützt die beobachtbare Semantik kleiner Nested-Completion-Beispiele.

checks.name: PackageIntegrityValidationCheck
checks.obligation: Required architecture files must be present; release package probes separately report runtime artifacts.
checks.description: Prüft das Paket als Kompatibilitäts- und Regressionsanker, ohne während laufender Tests erzeugte Cache-Dateien als Architekturfehler zu werten.

checks.name: MarkdownStageHistoryCheck
checks.obligation: The stage history must include the Stage-41 activated nested-completion documents.
checks.description: Prüft, dass die gelesene Markdown-Historie um Stage 41 fortgeschrieben wurde.

diagrams.text:
ArchitectureValidationBundle
├─ Category checks
│  ├─ functors reference known categories
│  ├─ natural transformations reference known functors
│  └─ paradigm terms remain visible
├─ Map checks
│  ├─ Stage-32 capsule map
│  ├─ known flow endpoints
│  └─ containment references
├─ Contract checks
│  ├─ capsule contract coverage
│  ├─ built-in contract validation
│  └─ diagram category/functor/transformation references
├─ Witness checks
│  ├─ anchor and capsule-slice coverage
│  ├─ diagram witnesses
│  ├─ refactor-law obligations
│  └─ natural-transformation witnesses
├─ Repository checks
│  ├─ package integrity
│  └─ Markdown stage history
├─ ArchitectureCoherenceBundle
│  └─ Stage-32 coherence matrix consumes the same validated stack
├─ ArchitectureTraceBundle
│  └─ Stage-32 component and capsule traces consume validation/coherence
├─ ArchitectureBoundariesBundle
│  └─ Stage-32 module boundary graph consumes package and map checks
├─ ArchitectureImpactBundle
│  └─ Stage-33 impact sources and migration gates consume traces, boundaries and contracts
├─ ArchitectureMigrationBundle
│  └─ Stage-34 migration waves consume impact candidates, contracts and gates
├─ ArchitectureRehearsalBundle
│  └─ Stage-35 rehearsal covers consume migration steps and gate suites
├─ ArchitectureActivationBundle
│  └─ Stage-36 activation transactions consume rehearsal moves, commit gates and rollback sections
├─ RowRangeMorphismBundle
│  └─ Stage-37 activated row-range morphisms consume the first activation envelope
├─ ArithmeticMorphismBundle
│  └─ Stage-38 activated arithmetic morphisms consume the next activation envelope
├─ ConsoleIOMorphismBundle
├─ WordCompletionMorphismBundle
│  └─ Stage-40 activated word-completion morphisms consume the fourth activation envelope
└─ NestedCompletionMorphismBundle
   └─ Stage-41 activated nested prompt-completion morphisms consume the next activation envelope
diagrams.mermaid:
```mermaid flowchart TD Category[CategoryTheoryBundle
categories + functors + natural transformations] --> Validation[ArchitectureValidationBundle] Map[ArchitectureMapBundle
capsules + flows + stages] --> Validation Contracts[ArchitectureContractsBundle
commutative diagrams + laws] --> Validation Witnesses[ArchitectureWitnessBundle
anchors + obligations] --> Validation Repo[Repository tree
package + Markdown history] --> Validation Validation --> Summary[Validation summary
passed / attention / failed] Validation --> Coherence[ArchitectureCoherenceBundle
cross-layer coherence matrix] Summary --> Future[Future stages
move code only when checks commute] Coherence --> Future Impact[ArchitectureImpactBundle
impact sources + migration gates] --> Validation Migration[ArchitectureMigrationBundle
waves + steps + gate bindings] --> Validation Rehearsal[ArchitectureRehearsalBundle
moves + gate suites + readiness covers] --> Validation Activation[ArchitectureActivationBundle
activation units + commit/rollback transactions] --> Validation RowRanges[RowRangeMorphismBundle
activated center row-range parser] --> Validation Arithmetic[ArithmeticMorphismBundle
activated center arithmetic] --> Validation ConsoleIO[ConsoleIOMorphismBundle
activated center console/help utilities] --> Validation WordCompletion[WordCompletionMorphismBundle
activated prompt word completion] --> Validation NestedCompletion[NestedCompletionMorphismBundle
activated nested prompt completion] --> Validation ```
